result.title: NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics | Now in Full Production
result.description:
NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics is now in full production — delivering the next generation of scale-out networking infrastructure for AI factories.

To reach gigawatt scale, AI factories require purpose-built networking. NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics delivers:
4x fewer lasers
5x lower power consumption
10x higher mean time between incidents

Built with world-class manufacturing partners across the full supply chain:
Silicon Photonics Fabrication — TSMC
Chip-Scale Packaging and Testing — SPIL
Laser Chip Fabrication — Lumentum
Laser Module Subassembly — TFC Communication
Switch System Assembly — Foxconn

Learn more about NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/spectrum-x

result.title: GTC SJ 2026: Physical AI for Healthcare Robotics - Simulation-First Design & Accelerated Development
result.description:
Discover how simulation-first design is radically changing how medical and healthcare robots are prototyped, tested, and built. As global healthcare systems navigate severe supply-and-demand crises, physical AI and robotics stand out as critical solutions to boost efficiency and clinical accuracy.

This session showcases how engineering teams leverage the NVIDIA Physical AI ecosystem - including world foundation models, physics-based simulations, high-fidelity digital twins, synthetic data generation, and real-time sensor-to-action deployment - to accelerate time-to-market while vastly lowering clinical risks long before technologies enter the operating room.
